subject: GlacierBank: sanitization request — prompts, inference logs, outputs
messages:
From: Daniel Price <security@glacierbank.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Deletion request — prompts, outputs, logs for FinPayments scope

Hi Alex,

We need Redwood's formal execution of a data sanitization request covering:
- all prompts and generated outputs associated with GlacierBank account ID GLB-44 for the FinPayments product (2024-06-01 through 2026-11-20),
- all inference logs (request/response traces and latency logs) stored in US residency, and
- any KV cache or model-derivative artifacts tied to that account.

Attached is our standard deletion form (filled). Please confirm the scope you will act on and provide an expected timeline, evidence format, and point of contact for operational questions. Per our compliance needs we require: a timestamped attestation, an artifact manifest (filenames and checksums), and confirmation that no backups or snapshots remain after the process.

I've CC'd Elena (DPO) on the thread. We need the deletion completed before our year-end audit window if possible.

Thanks,
Daniel Price
Head of Security Operations
Glacier Bank

[Attachment: glacierbank_deletion_form_v2.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood-inference.com>
To: Daniel Price <security@glacierbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Deletion request — prompts, outputs, logs for FinPayments scope

Daniel — thanks for sending the filled form and scope. We can support this. High-level plan and clarifying questions below.

High-level steps we propose (5 business-day baseline, configurable):
1) Scope confirmation and freeze window (24 hours): pin the dataset and prevent new writes to the GLB-44 keyspace.
2) Snapshot for evidence (read-only manifest + checksums).
3) Run expunge for prompts/outputs and remove KV cache entries.
4) Sweep inference logs + any backups/snapshots in the US residency region and storage class.
5) Deliver evidence bundle + signed attestation and close.

Clarifying Qs:
- Does GlacierBank require deletion of derivative embeddings/indices in addition to raw prompt/output artifacts?
- Any models that must be excluded (e.g., vendor-hosted models we don't control)?
- Preferred evidence format (our default: manifest.csv + checksums + runbook PDF + zipped log excerpts).

Marissa (Ops) and Grace (Compliance) are on the thread to own execution and attestation. I'll coordinate scheduling. Proposed target: start Monday 2026-11-23, complete by Friday 2026-11-27. Is that compatible with your audit window?

Alex Martinez
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
alex_martinez@redwood-inference.com
(415) 555-1212

[Attachment: redwood-erase-runbook-v1.2.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood-inference.com>, Daniel Price <security@glacierbank.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0500
Subject: RE: Deletion request — prompts, outputs, logs for FinPayments scope

Thanks Alex / Daniel — technical confirmation and execution notes below.

Execution plan (detailed):
- Identification: enumerate all objects by customer tag GLB-44 across:
  * prompt-output store (prompt-outputs/<year>/<account>/...),
  * inference-log bucket (us-east-1-inference-logs/glb-44/...),
  * KV caches (active nodes and cold snapshots).
- Freeze and access revoke: set a read-only freeze on GLB-44 keys and revoke ingestion tokens for that account.
- Evidence snapshot: generate manifest.csv listing object path, size, sha256. Store manifest in a secured evidence bucket (access limited to compliance team) and include md5/sha256 checksums.
- Expunge: sequential deletion job that removes live objects and issues lifecycle tombstones to prevent restoration from cold backups. We will run a compatibility pass for model-variant aliases to ensure no hidden references remain.
- Backup sweep: audit backup snapshots (7-day, 30-day, archive) and remove GLB-44 artifacts; if archive removal requires retention override, we'll file an escalation and provide expected completion time.
- KV cache purge: wipe and rotate affected cache shards; force eviction and invalidate cache manifests.
- Post-run verification: re-run enumeration to ensure zero objects; produce evidence bundle and runbook with timestamps, job IDs, and checksums.

Expected impact: short read-only freeze during the snapshot (~10–15 minutes). No expected downtime for customer-facing services outside ingestion freeze. If GlacierBank needs a narrower window we can adjust.

I'll own the expunge run and generate the evidence bundle. Grace will prepare the attestation language.

Marissa Cole
Senior Ops Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com

[Attachment: expunge-job-log-template.txt (text/plain)]

From: Elena Kovac <dpo@glacierbank.com>

Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 11:20:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Deletion request — prompts, outputs, logs for FinPayments scope

Thanks for the clear plan. A couple of compliance items to confirm before you run: 
- Evidence must include a signed attestation on company letterhead with run IDs and timestamps. We prefer DocuSign but will accept a signed PDF.
- Please include a manifest of any derivative artifacts (embeddings, index shards).
- For backups in cold storage, provide the expected completion time if an override is required; we need the audit trail to show when those objects are destroyed.

We approve your proposed 11/23–11/27 timeline if Glacier Bank receives the evidence bundle and signed attestation by 11/30.

Elena Kovac
Data Protection Officer
Glacier Bank

[Inline reply to Marissa's execution notes — appreciated.]

Daniel / Elena — quick update and closure:

We executed the expunge for GLB-44 today at 09:10 UTC (job ID: RBX-EX-20261126-09). Actions taken:
- Removed 13,412 prompt-output objects (manifest attached).
- Cleared inference-log shards for the requested period; performed a backup sweep in us-east-1 (snapshot override required, completed).
- Evicted and purged KV caches tied to GLB-44.

Evidence delivered: glacierbank_evidence_bundle_20261126.zip (contains manifest.csv, checksums.txt, expunge_job_report.pdf). A signed attestation has been submitted via DocuSign: https://docusign.example/GLB-2026-043-attestation

Next steps / notes:
- Please confirm you received the evidence bundle and whether the DocuSign attestation satisfies audit requirements.
- If you need additional artifacts (longer log excerpts or raw run logs) we can provide them under an evidence request ticket; these are retained for 30 days for audit review.

Thanks for working with us on the coordination. Closing here pending your confirmation.

Alex Martinez
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
alex_martinez@redwood-inference.com
